title: 第一卷 第334章 先生救我
slug: 纨绔世子爷公主退婚我造反
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

一群孩子围着念。

刘正平手都开始抖。

陈炎看着这一幕，忽然觉得挺好。

大宁公学第一堂课，字就该从这里学。

别先学风花雪月。

先学贪。

学怎么不被人当傻子坑。

周家的第一批银子被抬进县衙。

足足三万两。

还有一堆房契地契铺契。

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

A group of children gathered around and chanted.

Liu Zhengping's hands began to shake.

Chen Yan looked at this scene and suddenly felt very good.

The first class at Daning Public School is where you should learn Chinese characters.

Don’t imitate the romance first.

Learn to be greedy first.

Learn how not to be fooled by others.

The first batch of silver from the Zhou family was carried into the county government office.

A full thirty thousand taels.

There are also a bunch of house deeds and land deeds.
